title: Eleanor Weekender — Old Money — Nine Ad Storyboards
summary: Three approved old-money openings × Anna, eurofall-weekender-C3 and mer-oldmoney-C1. Same Eleanor Weekender body; travel and everyday outfit appeal. Three new grid-hook plates; all body B-roll and presenter identities are pre-existing. Woman Over 40, Eleven V3 Creative, with a raw conversational direction. Timing is provisional until voice alignment. All nine ads are text-free: narration carries the product name and CTA.

notes.title: VOICE — EXACT REQUEST
notes.text: Woman Over 40 · ElevenLabs Eleven V3 · Creative. Stability 0.0; similarity 0.85. Raw friend-to-friend read: natural breaths, varied emphasis, no announcer cadence or forced rasp. One continuous take per hook, shared across its three avatars. Audio generation and audible quality review are pending.

notes.title: HOW TO READ THE BOARD
notes.text: Nine ads = three complete sequences × three existing avatars. Start with the hook previews and avatar roster, then the nine combinations. Each H1/H2/H3 sequence continues left-to-right through its numbered sections. All approved words are preserved. A1 previews stand in for the selected avatar on presenter-only cards.

notes.title: NO SCREEN TEXT + LAYERING
notes.text: All nine ads: no on-screen text. No subtitles, captions, hook headlines, comparison labels, product titles or CTA overlays. 9:16; avatar approximately 30–35% width at the grid intersection, clear of faces, handles and hardware. Keep the chosen identity throughout.

notes.title: EDIT + SOUND
notes.text: Direct cuts follow the spoken cues. Hold the presenter for interpretation and the grid for comparisons. No repeated transition preset. Dry voice forward; optional music roughly 18–22 dB below it. Preserve breaths, avoid distracting SFX and hard gates. Re-align cuts after final voice selection. No on-screen text.

notes.title: CTA + END HOLD
notes.text: Final line names the Eleanor Weekender in the voice only. Hold the clean product image for 1.2 seconds after the last word. No CTA text, titles, sale or scarcity graphics. Existing end-frame plate is selected on C13.

notes.title: EXISTING B-ROLL
notes.text: Shared coverage comes from the existing Weekender library; no new common-body B-roll. These are prior generated brand assets, not documentary customer footage. H1 uses presenter holds on C02/C03 because travel and mirror scenes already appear in its bridge. Cross-ad reuse is intentional.

notes.title: ASSET REVIEW
notes.text: All three new grids and selected library sample strips inspected. Use the nominated short excerpts; the gold-detail insert ends at 1.5s before later image drift. Preserve Cognac canvas/leather and horizontal oval hardware. Size is not measured from these images. Continuous motion QA remains a production check.
